title: Meet an endangered African penguin
description: Join animal-care specialists for a close encounter, watching a penguin's curious behavior and learning about its care. Feather touching may be possible if the bird approaches voluntarily.
teaser: Join animal-care specialists for a close encounter, watching a penguin's curious behavior and learning about its care.
goodToKnow: The earlier research described a 45-minute small-group encounter at $75 plus admission. Check the current schedule, price and participation rules. No swimming is required.
